{{Top|leg}}
'''Mentors''' were [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] who were capable of teaching [[Dathomir Magic|spells]] to [[Initiate/Legends|Initiates]]. Mentors could be any Witch that had knowledge of the spell; even Initiates could be referred to as Mentors if they were called upon to teach a fellow student a spell they had learned. Generally, Mentors taught one spell at a time to an Initiate during the [[Time of Learning]]. However, it was possible for a Mentor to teach multiple spells to an Initiate at the same time.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
